The '''Broken Columns Clan''' was a group of [[Gender/Legends|men]], led and founded around [[33 ABY/Legends|33 ABY]] by the [[Hapan]]-born [[Tasander Dest]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. It was the only clan of men that did not attack the [[Raining Leaves Clan]], a tribe of [[Witches of Dathomir|Dathomiri witches]], shortly after the [[Raining Leaves Clan massacre|massacre]] that befell them. The two clans established a new custom: they convened every year near [[Redgill Lake]] and arranged [[Marriage/Legends|marriages]] that lasted one [[Standard year/Legends|year]]. Male children were handed over to their fathers, while female children remained with the Raining Leaves Clan.

==History==
In [[43 ABY|43.5 ABY]], during the year's annual [[Conclave of the Raining Leaves Clan and the Broken Columns Clan|conclave]], Dest married [[Kaminne Sihn]], the leader of the Raining Leaves Clan. The two clans later merged to form the [[Bright Sun Clan]].<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Backlash" />
